data.narrative:
Reditus Space is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Stef Crum (CEO, PhD in Space Systems Engineering with prior NASA and Space Force orbital operations experience) and Will Sherman (CTO). The company has raised $7.1M to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Only the Stage-Progression method is applicable given available data constraints. Using the $7.1M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields $17.75M. The Peer-Median approach cannot be applied; although 14 same-sector peers exist, none satisfy the narrow filters of identical stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier—a minimum of 3 datapoints is required to establish meaningful median. Public-Comp Anchoring is precluded because the target's revenue is not disclosed; while the Space & Aerospace public median trades at 27.4x P/S across 6 tickers, applying this multiple without revenue data would be speculative.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, with a median of $18M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression estimate to account for execution risk and founder caliber. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable seed-stage private transactions in narrow aerospace verticals and lack of revenue or technical milestone disclosure, limiting precision beyond this single-method conclusion.
